verdict.rationale: Plausible is a privacy-focused website analytics tool tracking anonymous visitors and pageviews; there is no evidence of account/company-level identity resolution, B2B account grouping, or CRM-style entity linking (e.g., grouping visits by company/organization). Custom properties (docs-63) allow attaching metadata but no evidence this is used to roll up behavior at an account level rather than per-session/user.
